section_name: AI Exchange: the world's AI security guide
body:
**300+ pages** of free, constantly-evolving, practical guidance on securing AI
systems. It covers the fundamentals and represents the closest publicly
available alignment of global expert consensus, feeding directly into the AI
Act and ISO standards through a unique SDO partnership.

The OWASP AI Exchange is a global think tank and open-source initiative that
brings together experts in AI and cybersecurity. Its mission is to bring
clarity in AI security by connecting practitioners, researchers, industry, and
policymakers.

_Technology with global impact requires global action._

[Get started](/docs/ai_security_overview/#how-to-use-this-document) [Ask
question (Google
login)](https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/75840a00-78f8-454d-ad4d-9ac27ae4cf48)

Your Guide to What's Inside
![AI Security Overview](/images/r1.png) 00

This section provides an overview of AI security — including threats,

Exchange.

Analysis](/go/riskanalysis/) [› How About...](/docs/ai_security_overview/#how-
about-)

[Learn more](/docs/ai_security_overview/)

![General controls](/images/r2.png) 01

These are the controls every organisation should have in place...

[› Governance controls](/go/governancecontrols/) [› Data
Limitation](/go/datalimit/) [› Limit unwanted behaviour](/go/limitunwanted/)

[Learn more](/docs/1_general_controls/)

![Input threats and controls](/images/r3.png) 02

Attacks by crafting inputs to AI, and their countermeasures...

[› Evasion](/go/evasion/) [› Prompt injection](/go/promptinjection/) [›

[Learn more](/docs/2_threats_through_use/)

what you can do about it...

[› Introduction](/go/developmenttime/) [› Model poisoning](/go/modelpoison/)
[› Dev. data leak](/go/devdataleak/)

[Learn more](/docs/3_development_time_threats/)

Attacks to the AI system in operation apart from the input attacks, and
protective controls...

leak](/go/augmentationdataleak/) [› Augmentation data

[Learn more](/docs/4_runtime_application_security_threats/)

![AI Security Testing](/images/r6.png) 05

AI security tests simulate adversarial behaviours to uncover vulnerabilities,
